title: Signs you're dating your best friend

slides.title: Signs you’re dating your *best friend*
slides.sub: Tag yours. You already know who they are.

slides.title: Silence is *comfortable.*
slides.body: No need to fill it. Being in the same room is enough.

slides.title: They’re the *first person* you tell.
slides.body: Good news, bad news, a weird dream. Them first.

slides.title: Your *inside jokes* need no context.
slides.body: One word and you’re both crying laughing.

slides.title: You can be *completely weird.*
slides.body: Bad singing, strange voices, zero judgment.

slides.title: They know your *usual.*
slides.body: Your food order, your coffee order, your hungry face.

slides.title: You’d pick them *as a friend* too.
slides.body: Even without the romance, you’d want them in your life.

slides.title: Save this *and send it to them.*
slides.sub: They’ll pretend it’s not about them. It is.
